edition: Paderewski / Bronarski / Turczynski (PWM): model-reviewed pitches, attacks, rhythm and dynamic levels; not a facsimile edition
provenance: Derived from the pinned NIFC Breitkopf & Hartel encoding, corrected against the exact local Paderewski Prelude scan; source originals retained

corrections: Include written B4 grace attacks in printed measures 11 and 19; the original XML contains them but the former Partitura importer skipped the GraceNote subclass.
Sustain B4 from the final triplet of printed measure 12 across the system break into measure 13, without a second attack.

Use scan spellings D#4 rather than Eb4 in printed measures 2, 3, 14 and 15; G#3 rather than Ab3 in measure 15; A#2 rather than Bb2 in measure 23. Sounding pitches are unchanged by these enharmonic corrections.
Retain the printed turn at measure 16. Its flexible realization is explicit and must not grant a strict technical level.
Repair the converted source's unterminated LH beam in printed measure 18, using the scan's two pairs followed by four eighth-note chords.
Use a grand staff with both voices on the lower staff in printed measures 24-25; retain the final bass octaves and full chord memberships.
Add written dynamic levels p at pickup, f at measure 17, p at measure 19 and pp at measure 24; preserve the cut-time meter, fermatas and source durations.
Preserve explicit tuplet bracket/number notation as well as time-modification values, so the reviewed triplet rhythm is visible in the symbolic preview.
